--format--: When a response needs lead cards, saved property cards, or image previews, request these formats first by replying with exactly --format-- and nothing else. After receiving this catalog, use the exact fenced block syntax below. Never return lead or property records as plain text or as unfenced objects. Output one lead or saved property block per item. Include only fields that have values; lead id and name are required. In the final answer, write a concise natural pretext before the first component block and a short relevant post-text after the last component block. Both must be outside the fenced blocks.
--format.image--:
For each image, use a neup.image fenced block containing a Markdown link: ```neup.image
[image URL](image URL)
```. Multiple images may be in one block, one link per line.
